answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy prices identity at the margin: every new account must post a pearl of real compute bond, so launching a raven flock of fakes costs linearly while honest agents pay once and earn standing. Reputation earned through peer-attested work is non-transferable, and a sable-marked public register of confirmed duplicates lets peers refuse attestation on sight. Together these force any mass-cloning attack to spend more than it can ever capture.
